identity.ground_fine_structure: Omega=1, v=0, J=1; two parity components

janaf.note: The notes shift all singlets using the assumed a1Delta origin. They describe this choice as uncertain, discard predicted unobserved 13000/15000 cm-1 levels, omit states near 32000 cm-1, and include rotation-vibration coupling and Q_r/Q_v corrections. Old thermal functions have an identified state-origin assumption, not simply a different D0.

jain2023.atomic_zero: Table I/Figure 1: Ti(a3F2)+O(3P2), not term centroids
jain2023.zero_point: Experimental D0 derives from ground-state ionization threshold and internally cooled ion DR, not the electronic well depth De. Do not subtract molecular ZPE again. Section V distinguishes theoretical De, D0 and spin-orbit corrections.
jain2023.fine_structure: Ion Omega=3/2,5/2, rotational cooling and product atomic fine-structure channels explicitly enter fragment fits.
jain2023.uncertainty_scope: Section IV.A extends beyond purely statistical 1 meV to account for model systematics; authors estimate effective one-sigma +/-10 meV. No covariance with legacy evaluation assumed.
jain2023.inspection: Published primary full text inspected via public ResearchGate text rendering, Sections II-VI and Appendices B/C; publisher PDF download blocked. Theory correction is not an additional correction to the reported experimental D0.

toto.partition_scope: 2019 Section 4.2 includes estimated higher D,F,g,h,i states in recommended Q. Current 20240509 states use the 2024 hybrid energies; downloaded PF is audited separately.
toto.limit: PF tabulated to8000K is not proof of physical completeness there; line-list metadata recommends5000K maximum. Review diagnostics300-5000K; runtime1500-4000K.
toto.normalization: Divide 47Ti16O by6 and49Ti16O by8. 46,48,50 have1. Do not abundance-weight raw Q or confuse isotope state origins with a natural-mixture thermochemical standard.

assessment.modern_direction: Prefer a complete modern partition plus Jain2023 energy candidate over retaining the 1973 thermal model indefinitely. This review does not yet supply a derivative-consistent production fit or finite equilibrium response.
assessment.legacy_source_gap: BC Table1 explicitly selects Luo6.869+/-.061; Luo original entry/citation chain and Gurvich1982 p99/p101 have not been independently inspected. Hildenbrand1976 is cited by Jain2023 and its publisher abstract is inspected; it is not assumed to be the proven direct Luo ancestor.
